data.name: Shirlee
data.long_meaning: Shirlee is derived from the Hebrew word ‘shir’ which means song or melody. It is also linked to the Greek word ‘leos’ meaning lion. The name Shirlee is gracious, gentle and full of strength, like a lioness in the wild. It has been popular in the Western world, especially in Christian and spiritual traditions, due to its beautiful meaning and associations with music, strength, and grace.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that evokes the power of song and the courage of the lion.
